_documentation.purpose: A 150 nm by 100 nm NbN film for laser-driven vortex motion toward a central vertical Josephson weak link.
_documentation.run_command: Not run directly; use the optical-junction experiment configuration.

fields.width: Film length across the junction in metres.
fields.height: Film width parallel to the junction in metres.
fields.nx: Mesh nodes across x; 151 gives 1 nm spacing.
fields.ny: Mesh nodes across y; 101 gives 1 nm spacing.
fields.contacts: Full-height current contacts on the left and right edges.
